defects.description: Incorrect grammatical case for the glossary term 'Фаза'. It should be in the accusative case ('в Фазу 3') after the preposition 'в'.
Literal translation of the English noun phrase 'Session Manifest' with incorrect word order. In Russian, the head noun should come first: 'Манифест сессии'.
Spelling error: 'Не восстанавливаемая' should be written as one word ('Невосстановимая') when used as a qualitative adjective without contrast.
Unnecessary bolding of glossary terms (e.g., консенсуса, сессия, роль) that is not present in the source text.
